Ingot with a composition of Zr50Ti35Nb15 (in at%) was prepared by arc-melting a mixture of the metallic elements with purity higher than 99.95 wt% in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere.
eventually drop-cast into rectangular cross-section copper molds with a dimension of 10 mm (width) x 10 mm (thickness) x 75 mm (length).
the ingot cuts into sheets with 3 mm thickness along the longitudinal section, followed by a cold-rolling with 50% reduction to 1.5 mm thickness.
Recrystallization annealing was then carried out at 0.5 Tm (Tm = 1884 K).
the XRD pattern indicates that the Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy has a single BCC solid solution structure.
The EBSD image taken from the cross-section of the as-cast bar shows a typical casting structure, which contains both equiaxed and columnar grains with grainsize ranging from 10 to 1100 μm.

attributes.location: grain boundaries and inside the crystal

evidence.quote: The mechanical twins appear in the shape of nano-scale lenticulars, most of which originate from the grain boundaries and terminate inside the crystal.
The fracture surface is mainly covered by plastic tear ridges as well as large-sized dimples
Moreover, Zone II shows the slip bands of the wave pattern.
The grains are remarkably refined, and the grain size is generally less than 100 μm.
pole figures also indicate that complete recrystallization carried out in the Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy without any preferred orientation
The fracture surface is mainly covered by plastic tear ridges as well as large-sized dimples
Many micropores have also been observed in the slip bands, which absorb energy during the deformation process
dislocation dipoles produced by dislocation cross-slip and the stress-induced deformation twins are clearly observed in the as-cast Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy

Complete recrystallization with a crystallinity of 96% was achieved in the Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy.

it can be estimated that the (σ0.2)mix of the Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy obtainted from the inherent yield strength of pure elements is 244 MPa, which is much smaller than the experimental values (657 MPa).
Then, lattice distortion contribution based on Labusch approach is approximately quantified to be σa ≈ 117 MPa
the modulus misfit contribution is approximately quantified to be σG ≈ 312 MPa.
total contributions of (σ0.2)mix, σa and σG to the yield strength of Zr50Ti35Nb15 alloy can be predicted by σ0.2 = (σ0.2)mix + σa + σG, and the yield strength is estimated to ~673 MPa.
The ultimate goal of designing the concentrated solid-solution is to obtain a larger degree of solid solution strengthening without priducting any ordered phase.

the interaction of cross-slip and deformation twins resulting in the stable plastic deformation, and dynamic grain refinement due to the interaction of dislocation and twins also ensures such excellent mechanial properties.
The mechanical twinning promotes the new slip systems to start, thus ensuring the continuous plastic deformation.
